widgets_values:
DEFINE art test, round 1: style exploration

1. If a model box below is red, click it and pick your Z-Image Turbo files (diffusion model, qwen_3_4b text encoder, ae VAE).
2. Press Run once. It makes 12 images: 4 styles x 3 costumes.
3. Outputs land in ComfyUI/output/define/.
4. Upload the PNGs (originals, not screenshots: they carry the seeds) to art/inbox/round1 on the GitHub branch, or paste your favourites into chat.

Modern American comic book illustration, bold confident black ink linework, dynamic cel shading with crisp graphic shadow shapes, vibrant saturated colors, professional comic cover quality.

Full-body character design of an original superhero, an adult man with an athletic build, standing facing the viewer in a confident heroic stance, feet shoulder-width apart, arms relaxed and held slightly away from his body, the whole figure visible from head to toe with empty space around it. He wears a sleek form-fitting suit in hot magenta and deep navy with electric cyan accent lines along the arms and sides, navy gloves and boots, and a short sunset-orange cape that hangs behind his shoulders. A navy domino mask covers his eyes, with glowing cyan eye lenses; short dark hair. On his chest is a bold geometric emblem: a white diagonal dumbbell inside a cyan diamond. Plain flat pale grey background, no scenery, no text, no logos, no watermark.
